text:
Assistant A provides a well-structured, coherent outline with clear subheadings (Introduction, Design, Performance, Camera, UI, Price, Conclusion) and specific bullet points that effectively organize the comparison of features, performance, and user experience within the word limit. Assistant B, by contrast, produces repetitive, contradictory statements (e.g., claiming both models have sharper cameras and faster processors) without any actual outline structure, subheadings, or logical organization, failing to deliver a usable blog post framework.

[[A]]
